items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: Hold Me Parson, I Feel Religion coming on.

ctx.x: I just picked up that. That's all right, Daddy, and keep on knocking, number two. I got that myself the other day.
Keep knocking, but you can't come in? Yeah. Yeah, and then Hold Me Parson, I Feel Religion coming on. You got that one?
No, I don't got that. I got to keep on knocking, number two.
